snippet.title: BUNKER 73 | Scream Jam 2024 trailer
snippet.description:
https://bragekh.itch.io/bunker-73

The bunker has been abandoned for a while now, hooligans go in there to smoke and to party, but people have gone missing over the years....

Can you figure out why? Photograph any ghosts you might find, and remember to get their faces...

Created in 7 days for Scream Jam 2024 on itch.io! Made by Brage Kasa Hansen, Anders Brynildsen,  Bjørn Husby and Ollie Hall.
